body:
Now all widgets but: hits, pagination, indexSelector have header and footer templates features.

It's using an `headerFooter` decorator to share this common behavior. 

I was able to remove some good code also by making `toggle` widget use `RefinementList` and by removing the places where we had to `<Template header..>`

comments.body: I'm really glad you went on and implement HOC :) Looks very good! (made a suggestion though ;)
This one is ready for review and merge

> I'm really glad you went on and implement HOC :) Looks very good! (made a suggestion though ;)

Yes this is a nice pattern that we should maybe talk about a little in a blog post. This is very different from Component extend AnotherComponent as we talked because inheritance do not allow the Parent to control the render() behavior. While when compositing you can. And this is what we needed here.

title: feat(widgets): add headerFooter behavior to relevant widgets
